import json,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from android_world.task_evals.single import clock
from android_world.env.representation_utils import UIElement
rows=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); root=Path(sys.argv[2]); out=[]
for row in rows:
 values=json.loads((root/row['rawUiElementsPath']).read_text())
 elements=[UIElement(**v) for v in values]
 actual=clock._is_stopwatch_running(elements,row['currentActivity'])
 assert actual==row['predicateReturn']
 out.append({'label':row['label'],'elementCount':len(elements),'offlinePredicateReturn':actual,'matchesRecordedOriginalReturn':True})
print(json.dumps({'scope':'Offline replay of serialized actual official elements for consistency only; no new scoring/device operation','module':clock.__file__,'moduleSha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(clock.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'rows':out}))
